storageClass.description: StorageClass for all tenant PVCs. Empty uses the cluster default StorageClass.

toolsets.description: Toolset entries rendered into the toolset-config ConfigMap. Keyed by toolset name.

image.description: Tool job image the harness spawns for this toolset.

keepalive.description: Keep the tool job warm: Job restartPolicy OnFailure plus idle-reap instead of one-shot.

deadlineSeconds.description: Per-tool-job runtime bound (activeDeadlineSeconds). Overrides the framework default when set.

env.description: Env vars forwarded verbatim into the tool job: key as the name, scalar as the value.

model.description: Model destinations keyed by model key. The key IS the turn's `model` value; an absent key is refused, never defaulted. Read directly by the harness, never looked up by name in the toolsets map, and bound by no workspace.

image.description: Inference job image the harness spawns for this model.

format.description: Provider wire format the inference image speaks.

model.description: The provider's own model id, which need not match the model key.

baseUrl.description: Provider API base URL, passed as-is including any version path (e.g. https://api.anthropic.com/v1).

secret.description: Kubernetes Secret carrying the provider credential, mounted read-only into the inference Job. Omit when the baseUrl needs no credential.

inference.description: In-cluster inference workloads, keyed by the model key each serves. Presence of a key makes that model's baseUrl resolve to a local Service.

image.description: Inference engine image ref (the llama.cpp server).

weights.description: OCI image ref holding the GGUF weight file.

weightsPath.description: Path to the GGUF file inside the weight image.

weightsDelivery.description: How the weight image reaches the pod: kubelet image volume (mount) or init-container copy into an emptyDir (copy).

contextBudget.description: KV buffer size in tokens, split across slots.

threads.description: Pinned thread count, never the engine's automatic value.

temp.description: Sampling temperature passed as --temp. 0 is greedy/deterministic (verbatim output); omit to run the engine's own default.

memory.description: Kubernetes memory quantity for the container limit.

cpu.description: CPU count for the container limit.

singleNodeException.description: Operator attestation that inference and toolset pods may share a node. Drops the node selector and toleration.

chatTemplate.description: Optional chat template content mounted into the server and passed as --chat-template-file. Empty (default) runs the engine on its weight-embedded template.

instructions.description: Object-storage delivery of instruction content. The harness init container syncs each workspace's prefix from this endpoint/bucket using the named read-only credential; the serving container mounts the result read-only and holds no credential.

endpoint.description: Cross-namespace Service address (host:port) of the shared cluster object store the sync init container reaches. The harness egress netpol reads the store namespace from this host.

bucket.description: Bucket holding every workspace's instruction tree.

credentialName.description: Name of the (Sealed)Secret carrying the read-only, prefix-scoped sync credential (produced SaaS-side). Mounted into the init container only.

syncImage.description: Image for the object-storage sync init container (carries the sync client).

capabilityManifest.description: The workspace's capability manifest document, produced out-of-band by `syco toolset manifest` per bound image and supplied via --set-file. Rendered verbatim into the content-addressed capability-manifest-<ws>-<hash> ConfigMap (immutable; a changed manifest yields a new object). Absent renders an empty {tools: []} manifest.

cpu.description: Kubernetes CPU quantity for the harness container (requests = limits).

memory.description: Kubernetes memory quantity for the harness container (requests = limits).

storage.description: Workspace PVC size. Defaults to 1Gi when absent.

conversationStorage.description: Conversation-history PVC size for this workspace's harness. Defaults to 1Gi.

toolsets.description: Toolsets this workspace is bound to. An item is either a bare toolset name or an object naming the toolset and the grants calls may select from.

grants.description: The closed set of credentials a tool call against this toolset may select. Keyed by grant name.

secret.description: Kubernetes Secret carrying the credential under a data key equal to the Secret's own name.

path.description: Absolute path the credential file lands at. Defaults to /run/secrets/grant/credential.

egress.description: The one domain the chart opens for this grant. A grant declaring none stays on the baseline floor.

instructions.description: This workspace's instruction content location in object storage. The sync init container pulls this prefix from harness.instructions.bucket.

prefix.description: This workspace's key prefix within harness.instructions.bucket. Defaults to <namespace>/<workspace> when omitted.

serverUrl.description: Public URL clients use to reach headscale. Required when enabled=true.

email.description: Email registered with Let's Encrypt. Required when acme.enabled=true.

channels.description: Channel instances this tenant serves. The map key is the instance name and becomes the pod's sycophant.md/channel label; presence in the map is the enable signal.

loginServer.description: Headscale URL the adapter joins. Required.

authKeySecret.description: Pre-existing Secret with key `authkey` (headscale pre-auth key).
